title: Lost at sea: is the Bermuda Triangle worse than its traffic?
excerpt: I placed 472 famous disappearances on the map and tested every sea against its shipping. The Bermuda Triangle has 8 against 2.8 expected, but its neighbours run just as high, and most of its famous cases happened outside it.
seo_description: 472 famous disappearances at sea tested against shipping traffic: the Bermuda Triangle is no worse than its neighbours.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Lost at sea' in black and red on pale paper, asking whether the Bermuda Triangle is worse than its traffic would predict, with '8 v 2.8' in red, beside a map of the dashed Bermuda Triangle over blue shipping lanes with white and red dots for famous disappearances.
